name: 道の駅 原鶴
desc: 福岡県朝倉市にある道の駅「原鶴（ファームステーションバサロ）」は、原鶴温泉の玄関口に位置します。特産品は「フルーツの里」ならではの富有柿やぶどう、梨などの新鮮な果物。柿チップや名物の「巨峰ソフト」も大人気です。最大の特徴は、駅の目の前に広がる広大な畑。春は約60万本の菜の花、秋は約16万本のひまわりが咲き誇り、四季折々の絶景と地元食材の買い物を同時に満喫できる魅力的なスポットです。
descEn: Located in Asakura City, Fukuoka Prefecture, Roadside Station "Harazuru" (Farm Station Basaro) serves as the gateway to Harazuru Onsen. True to its reputation as a "Village of Fruits," it offers an abundance of fresh local specialties, including Fuyu persimmons, grapes, and pears. Dried persimmon chips and the famous Kyoho grape soft-serve ice cream are also highly popular. The station's greatest feature is the vast field spreading right in front of it. Blooming with approximately 600,000 canola flowers in spring and 160,000 autumn sunflowers, it is a fantastic spot where you can simultaneously enjoy stunning seasonal scenery and shop for fresh local produce.
